system.description:
Ability Score Increases. +1 to Strength and one other ability score.

Skill Proficiencies. Nature and your choice of either Animal Handling or Deception.

Suggested Equipment (cost 11 gp). Block and tackle, Explorer’s Pack.

Feature: Fisherman’s Tale. Whether you’re inflating tales of your exploits or actually telling the honest truth, you have an uncanny ability to fool the average listener. If you are able to spend at least 1 minute telling a tale of your exploits (fish-related or otherwise) to a crowd, you gain an expertise die to checks made to omit or otherwise alter details to the listeners.

Adventures and Advancement: River Monster. Even if most of your tales are largely made-up or embellished, as your reputation for fishing grows, people will approach you with tales of the lunker in the lake or what they think is a massive fish that resides beneath the surface of the local river. Sometimes these river monsters are just fish, but sometimes the term “monster” is meant literally.

Connection and Memento. Roll 1d10, choose, or make up your own.
